results.content:
Refunds and Billing — Duplicate charges
If you see two identical charges for one order, one is usually a temporary authorization that disappears within 3 business days. If both charges are captured (marked "posted"), contact us with the order number and we will refund the duplicate immediately.

results.title: Changing or Cancelling an Order
results.content:
Changing or Cancelling an Order — Change shipping address
You can change the shipping address free of charge while the order status is "processing" (before it ships). Once an order has shipped, the address cannot be changed — the carrier may offer a redirect from the tracking page.

results.title: Returns Policy
results.content:
Returns Policy — Exchanges
We don't do direct exchanges. Return the item for a refund and place a new order.

results.title: Returns Policy
results.content:
Returns Policy — How to start a return
Reply to your order confirmation email or contact support with your order number. We email a prepaid return label (US) within one business day. Refunds are issued within 2 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse.
